newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil product all firm, relentless mogas up $5.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil product all firm, relentless mogas up $5.

text.p: NWE oil products all firmed on Tuesday morning, with gasoline again taking the lead by gaining some $5 a tonne, dealers said.
Eurograde gasoline barges traded at $234 and $236 fob Rotterdam in early business before being offered at $239, a level which failed to attract the next buyer.
"The market's probably just catching its breath," one trader said.
August swaps rose to around $224 fob ARA and the August/September spread widened slightly to $20 a tonne.
Regular gasoline quotes were a mere $6 below eurograde.

Heating oil barges gained by $3/$4 a tonne as August IPE gas oil futures strengthened. The continued strength of the futures market and the dollar deterred most buyers, particularly as some believed Russian cargoes would soften the market soon.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were around $2 a tonne. One barge sold at $95.50 fob Rotterdam for loading August 10-20. Prompt material was offered at $97.
Traders said prompt fuel oil was very hard to find with almost nothing available from refiners and loading delays at two key independent storage sites.
